## Budget Dinner Plan for 6 People

A $75 total budget is very workable here if you lean on rice, pasta, tacos, and sheet-pan meals. I’ve chosen options that can be made in under 45 minutes and adapted for one vegetarian guest and one gluten-avoiding guest.

## 4 Fast Dinner Ideas That Fit the Group

| Dinner idea | Why it works | Time | Budget fit |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| Taco bar with seasoned beans + chicken | Easy to split into vegetarian and gluten-free plates with corn tortillas | 30–35 min | About $55–$70 |
| Lemon garlic chicken, rice, and roasted vegetables | Naturally gluten-free; make a bean plate for the vegetarian guest | 35–40 min | About $50–$65 |
| Rice bowls with teriyaki tofu, chicken, and vegetables | Flexible build-your-own format; use tamari instead of soy sauce | 35–40 min | About $45–$65 |
| Baked potato bar with chili toppings | Very budget-friendly, filling, and easy to keep gluten-free | 40–45 min | About $35–$55 |

## Best Pick for the Whole Group

**Safest choice: Taco bar with seasoned beans + chicken**

Why this is the safest:
- Easy to keep **gluten-free** by using **corn tortillas** and checking seasoning labels
- Easy to keep **vegetarian** with beans, rice, cheese, salsa, and toppings
- No mushrooms needed
- Fast, filling, and low-risk for cross-contamination if toppings are separated
- Usually the best balance of **price, speed, and flexibility**

## Shopping List Outline

### Shared staples
- Rice or tortillas
- Shredded cheese
- Salsa
- Lettuce or cabbage
- Tomatoes or pico de gallo
- Onions
- Garlic
- Limes
- Oil
- Salt, pepper, cumin, chili powder

### Protein options
- Chicken thighs or breasts
- Canned black beans or pinto beans
- Tofu, if choosing the rice bowl option
- Canned chili beans, if choosing the baked potato option

### Produce
- Bell peppers
- Onions
- Lettuce or cabbage
- Avocados, optional
- Potatoes, if choosing the baked potato option
- Broccoli or zucchini, if you want an easy vegetable side

### Gluten-free basics to check
- Corn tortillas
- Tamari instead of regular soy sauce
- Taco seasoning labeled gluten-free, or use spices directly
- Broth, if using any, labeled gluten-free

## Quick Build for the Safest Dinner

### Taco Bar Menu
- **Main:** Corn tortillas with seasoned chicken and black beans
- **Vegetarian plate:** Beans, rice, cheese, salsa, lettuce, avocado
- **Sides:** Corn, simple salad, or sautéed peppers and onions
- **Optional extras:** Sour cream, hot sauce, lime wedges

### Time Plan
- 10 min: Chop vegetables and set toppings out
- 15 min: Cook chicken and beans with spices
- 10 min: Warm tortillas and rice
- 5 min: Assemble and serve
